brand.name: Kunda Space
brand.subtagline: Urubuga rwizewe rwo guhura n'umukunzi mu Rwanda no hanze yarwo.

hero.badge: Urubuga rwizewe rwo gushaka umukunzi mu Rwanda
hero.title: Guhura Nyako Kwubakiye ku Kwizerana n'Intego Zihuje
hero.subtitle: Hura n'abasore n'inkumi b'Abanyarwanda ndetse n'abari hanze bashaka urukundo ruzira uburyarya, kubaka urugo, no gukundana.

howItWorks.title: Uko Kunda Space Ikora
howItWorks.subtitle: Intambwe eshatu zoroshye kandi zizewe zo kubona uwo mukundana.
howItWorks.step1Desc: Emeza imyaka yawe (18+), hitamo icyo ushaka mu rukundo, ibyo ukunda n'amafoto meza.
howItWorks.step2Desc: Ikoranabuhanga riguhuza n'abantu muhuje intego z'ubuzima, imico n'imyizerere.
howItWorks.step3Desc: Koresha ubutumwa bw'ubuntu, muganire mu mutekano, mwembi mwabyumvikanaho mugurane nimero.

safety.title: Umutekano n'Ibanga Biza Imbere
safety.subtitle: Twubatse Kunda Space mu buryo burinda amakuru yawe kugira ngo ushake umukunzi utekanye.
safety.pillar1Desc: Itariki y'amavuko igomba kwemezwa kuri seriveri. Nta mwana uri munsi ya 18 wemerewe kwinjira.
safety.pillar2Desc: Nimero za telefone ziba zifunze mu butumwa. Zifungurwa gusa iyo mwembi mwabyumvikanye.
safety.pillar3Desc: Ikoranabuhanga ryacu rihagarika ubutumwa busebya abandi cyangwa abashaka gutekera abantu umutwe.

plans.title: Ibiciro Byoroshye kandi Bisobanutse
plans.subtitle: Tangira ku buntu. Ishyura gusa igihe wifuza gukomeza kuganira birenzeho.
plans.freeDesc: Ubutumwa bw'ubuntu bwa mbere n'ibisubizo by'ubuntu byo gutangira umubano.
plans.dailyDesc: Ubutumwa budafite umupaka mu masaha 24. Byihuse kandi byoroshye.
plans.threeDayDesc: Kwandikirana ubutumwa budafite umupaka mu masaha 72 yose.
plans.weeklyDesc: Uburenganzira bwuzuye mu minsi 7 no kugaragara mbere mu bakobwa n'abasore.
plans.payPerMsgDesc: Ishyura gusa 150 RWF ku butumwa wohereje iyo ubufasha bw'ubuntu burangiye.
plans.contactUnlockDesc: Fungura nimero ya telefone igihe mwembi mwabyemeranyijweho.

auth.suspendedError: Konti yawe yarahagaritswe. Nyamuneka vugisha abashinzwe ubufasha.

wizard.underageWarning: Ugomba kuba ufite nibura imyaka 18 kugira ngo winjire muri Kunda Space.
wizard.phoneNotice: Nimero yawe iguma mu ibanga 100% ntabwo ijya ku karubanda.
wizard.bioPlaceholder: Bwira abagushaka icyo utandukaniyeho n'abandi, ibyo ukunda, n'uwo wifuza...
wizard.skinTonePref: Icyo Wifuza ku Mubiri (Urugero rw'amafoto y'abakuze)
wizard.skinToneNotice: Aya mafoto ni urugero rwo kwereka ibyifuzo, si abanyamuryango nyakuri.
wizard.photosNotice: Shyiraho amafoto agaragara neza yawe ubwawe. Amafoto meza atuma ubona abagukunda byikubye inshuro 4.
wizard.termsAgree: Ndemeza ko mfite nibura imyaka 18 kandi nemeye Amabwiriza y'Urubuga n'Umutekano.

dashboard.moderationWarning: Kwandika nimero muri chat birabujijwe. Nyamuneka ganirira muri Kunda Space.

wallet.title: Ikofi ya Kunda Space
wallet.subtitle: Koresha amafaranga mu mucyo mu kohereza ubutumwa no gufungura nimero.

footer.tagline: Guhuza imitima mu Rwanda no hirya no hino ku Isi.
footer.rights: Uburenganzira bwose burabitswe. Byagenewe abantu bafite imyaka 18+ gusa.
